concerns.text: FR-003 (Planned Directional Contrasts) and SC-001 (Primary Outcome Measurement) lack a dedicated task. T030 implements contrasts but is tagged [US2] and depends on T035a (Manipulation Check). The spec requires contrasts to test the hypothesis, but the task dependency chain blocks execution if the manipulation check fails, potentially leaving the hypothesis untested without a fallback or explicit 'halt and report' task for the contrast logic itself.

FR-005 (Multiple-Comparison Correction) and SC-005 (Type I Error Control) are not explicitly covered by a task. T031 implements Tukey HSD but is tagged [US2] and depends on T030. The spec mandates correction for all pairwise comparisons, but the task dependency chain (T030 -> T031) implies correction only happens if T030 runs. There is no task explicitly verifying the correction logic or handling the case where T030 fails but correction is still required for reporting.

SC-002 (Pre-study Power Calculation Report) is addressed by T002, but T002 is marked as rejected/missing in the Analyze report. The task exists but its artifact is missing, creating a gap in coverage for the success criterion. The task description is present, but the execution status (rejected) means the SC is not satisfied.

SC-004 (Trust Scale Verification) is addressed by T010b-auto, T011, and T007g, but T011 is marked as FAILED in the Analyze report. The task chain exists, but the failure of T011 means the verification step is incomplete, leaving SC-004 unsatisfied.

Task T007g is tagged [SC-004] but the Analyze report indicates it is rejected/missing. While the task exists in the text, its status means the coverage is broken. This is a writing/requirement issue because the task description is present but the execution is blocked.

Task T030 is tagged [US2] but the Analyze report indicates it depends on T035a (Manipulation Check) which is a prerequisite. The task description mentions 'Execute planned directional contrasts UNCONDITIONALLY', but the dependency chain in the text (T030 depends on T035a) contradicts the 'unconditional' claim. This is a writing inconsistency in the task description vs. dependency logic.

Task T031 is tagged [US2] and [FR-005] but the Analyze report indicates it depends on T030. The task description says 'Execute Tukey HSD... UNCONDITIONALLY', but the dependency chain implies it only runs if T030 runs. This is a writing inconsistency in the task description vs. dependency logic.

Task T042 is tagged [FR-006] but the Analyze report indicates it depends on T008-init-std and T008-CLI-EXPOSE, while T008 depends on T042. This creates a circular dependency that breaks the coverage for FR-006 (Sensitivity Analysis) because the protocol cannot be generated until the config is finalized, but the config cannot be finalized until the protocol ranges are validated.

Task T008-CLI-EXPOSE is tagged [FR-006] but the Analyze report indicates it depends on T008-init-std, which in turn depends on T000-GATE-METADATA. The task description mentions 'Override the values in code/analysis/config.yaml at runtime', but the dependency chain implies the config is not yet finalized. This is a writing inconsistency in the task description vs. dependency logic.

Task T008-VALIDATE is tagged [P] but the Analyze report indicates it depends on T008 and T042. The task description says 'Verify that sensitivity_config in config.yaml matches the ranges in protocol.md', but the dependency chain implies the protocol is not yet generated. This is a writing inconsistency in the task description vs. dependency logic.
